messages:
Sam: heads-up, p99 for /v1/stream spiked ~45% in the endpoints percentile pane around 01:42 UTC. p50/p95 look flat. anyone else seeing a tail-only event?
Priya: which Console view & filters? endpoint, region, model?
Sam: Observability -> Latency -> Endpoints. filters: region=us-east, model=redwood-13b, endpoint=/v1/stream. link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/stream
Lina: quick telemetry check: there were a few fallback decisions to pool:legacy-warm between 01:40-01:44 with reason=quota_burst. small fraction of traffic but big tail. log sample: `{"ts":"2026-03-10T01:41:12Z","tenant":"retail-ops","route":"api-realtime","decision":"fallback","target":"pool:legacy-warm","reason":"quota_burst"}`
Marcus: important question for Console: are percentiles computed by merging t-digests across shards or by merging per-origin percentiles? the latter underestimates tails if origins have different counts.
Priya: backend uses merged t-digests (correct math). problem is the UI rollup hides origin/sample counts by default, so the p99 looks like a system-wide regression.
Sam: yeah that's the UX problem. users see a single p99 and assume platform regression.
Lina: another factor: sampling rates differ per proxy. some proxies sample 1/10, others 1/100. if legacy-warm sampled more during that minute, it can over-represent the tail in the p99 calculation.
Marcus: proposals: (1) short-term: show total_sample_count alongside p50/p95/p99 and add a tiny origin badge listing top origin + pct; (2) add a low-sample warning when sample_count < 50; (3) add a one-click drilldown that reruns percentiles grouped by sample_origin.
Priya: I can ship #1 and #2 as a small UI patch today. will include the drilldown link for #3, ETA EOD.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-service v1.9 deployed at 2026-03-10T01:20:00Z (sha: ab12cd) :gear:
Sam: policy: also update the alerting rule to suppress p99 alerts when total_sample_count < 100 or when top_origin_percent < 15% to reduce noise from tiny-origin tails.
Marcus: agree, I'll update the alert rules and add a note in playbooks explaining merged t-digest semantics and how to attribute tails.
Priya: action items: PR for sample_count+badge+low-sample hint (WIP), Marcus will change alert suppression, Lina to run raw sample counts for 01:35-01:50 and post results.
Sam: thanks — I'll ping CS/oncall if we see customer reports. close after PR lands and we confirm tail reduces after routing tweak. :thumbsup:
